Definition: of Latin origin; a quadrans, i.e. the fourth part of an as:--farthing.
BiblicalUsage: Kodrantes is a quadrans, a farthing, the smallest Roman coin. Matthew 5:26 warns the debtor shall not come out till he has paid the uttermost farthing, and Mark 12:42 shows the poor widow throwing in two mites, which make a farthing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the farthing is the measure of two opposite things: the debt that must be paid to the last coin, and the gift that is worth more than all the rich men's offerings.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
